title: Security & Privacy Audit

real_gaps_found_and_fixed.description: intelligence/device_ai had no authentication on any route (register/confirm/finalize/enrich/passport/anchor/reanchor/trust) -- backend JWT/RBAC never sits in front of it, and its port is host-mapped in docker-compose.yml for demo convenience
real_gaps_found_and_fixed.discovered_by: P8.7 authentication-category audit (grep across api/*.py and application.py for auth dependencies -- zero hits)
real_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: opt-in, backward-compatible ServiceApiKeyMiddleware (api/service_auth.py) gated by new Settings.service_api_key (default None = open, unchanged pre-P8.7 behavior); required in production via the existing _validate_production_safety validator; public allowlist for health/meta/blockchain-health routes
real_gaps_found_and_fixed.live_verification: rebuilt device-ai container; default (no key) unchanged (404 not 401); isolated throwaway container with SERVICE_API_KEY set: no-header=401, wrong-key=401, correct-key=404 (reached handler), /health-no-header=200

real_gaps_found_and_fixed.description: both mobile apps' AppConfig.apiBaseUrl defaults to http://10.0.2.2:3000 (Android emulator alias) with no enforcement that a release build actually override it to https://
real_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: new assertSecureApiUrl({url, isReleaseMode}) in lib/core/config/secure_url_guard.dart (both apps), throws InsecureApiUrlError when isReleaseMode && !url.startsWith('https://'); wired into main() before runApp; debug/profile builds unaffected

authorization_matrix_built.note: full 5-role x every backend route matrix built from source (every authorize() call read directly, not inferred)
